newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU cable/telecoms report due in June - Van Miert.
newsitem.headline: EU cable/telecoms report due in June - Van Miert.

text.p: A study for the European Commission on the link between cable television and telecommunications networks is expected to be completed in June, EU Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said on Thursday.
He told a news conference the Commission would try to "draw conclusions" on the report by the end of the year.

The Commission ordered the independent study as part of an analysis of whether it should take action against dominant phone companies that operate cable TV networks as part of its broader effort to liberalise telecoms markets.
Van Miert said in a 1996 speech that the Commission would look at three options, including requiring such companies to divest their cable operations.
The other options were to maintain the status quo and to lift existing constraints on telecom operators who want to provide cable TV services.
The Commission denied reports in January, however, that it had specific plans to force Deutsche Telekom to sell part or all of its cable TV network. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
